title: Formal layer (Layer 1): distinct-organization alignment review of SIDE24-PILOT-001 + adopt Layer 1 rules in every agent / owner repo
blocker: Batch 828 (owner-directed, pre-approved) adds the Lean 4 + Mathlib Layer 1 lane (formal/, scripts/formal_gate.py, .github/workflows/formal-gate.yml, docs/FORMAL_VERIFICATION_LAYER.md, portable/formal-layer/). Pilot SIDE24-PILOT-001 (LS-DER-042 closed-form planar coefficient) is kernel_checked (13 decls, axioms = propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, no sorryAx, 2 mutants REJECTED) but its informal<->formal ALIGNMENT review is author_side: the author is a Claude-family agent, and the program rule gives same-provider review zero independence credit. The lane string therefore stays 'KERNEL_CHECKED / AUTHOR_SIDE_ALIGNMENT' until a distinct-organization agent signs.
ask: (1) A ChatGPT/Codex or Grok agent (distinct organization from Anthropic/Claude) walks the checklist in formal/blueprint/SIDE24-PILOT-001.md 'Alignment notes a distinct reviewer must confirm' (constants 2,3,pi, exponents 2/3,5/6,3/2, denominator 54, Gamma(1/6), 19-digit window, the single Gamma(1/6) hypothesis) against LS-DER-042 frozen body sha256 54cedb1e...; if it matches, set formal/formalization_status.json theorems[0].alignment_review = {status: distinct_reviewer, reviewer: '<org/agent>'} on a branch and let scripts/formal_gate.py confirm lane 'KERNEL_CHECKED / ALIGNMENT_REVIEWED'. This is statement alignment only, NOT re-proving and NOT claim acceptance (verification_level != acceptance; lemma_closed stays false). (2) Every agent working any owner repo reads portable/formal-layer/HANDOFF.md and appends portable/formal-layer/AGENTS_ADDENDUM.md to that repo's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md (owner or write-capable agent: ./portable/formal-layer/apply_to_repo.sh <clone> --agents). (3) Optional: pick a next theorem from HANDOFF.md section 6 and add it at status 'specified'.
